snippet.title: [UK] Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension | Mega Garchomp Z​ Appears! 💥
snippet.description:
Claim the Mystery Gift available in Pokémon Legends: Z-A starting 27 February to detect a special hyperspace distortion in the Mega Dimension DLC. 

Obtain a Garchompite Z stone by defeating the Mega Garchomp Z that appears in this pocket of hyperspace. If you give a Garchomp on your team the Garchompite Z stone to hold, it will then be able to Mega Evolve into Mega Garchomp Z!
